title: Duty to report illegal acts.
bodyText: A Hawaii financial institution shall immediately notify the commissioner in writing of any act of robbery, embezzlement, or fraud committed in connection with its affairs whenever the concerned act involves a sum in excess of $100,000.
bodyHtml: §412:3-114  Duty to report illegal acts.  A Hawaii financial institution shall immediately notify the commissioner in writing of any act of robbery, embezzlement, or fraud committed in connection with its affairs whenever the concerned act involves a sum in excess of $100,000. [L 1993, c 350, pt of §1; am L 2006, c 228, §14]
